enhanced_information: The translocation t(15;17)(q22;q11) leads to the formation of the PML-RARA fusion protein, disrupting normal hematopoiesis and causing Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL). analysis: The translocation t(15;17)(q22;q11) is specifically associated with acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL). This translocation results in the fusion of the PML gene on chromosome 15 with the RARA gene on chromosome 17, leading to the formation of the PML-RARA fusion gene, which is a hallmark of APL.
